verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents storing passkeys in its own vault and autofilling them through the browser extension and mobile apps. Because passkeys live in the Bitwarden vault rather than a platform vendor's keychain, they can be used across those clients. However, the evidence never names the specific ecosystems (iOS, Android, Windows, Linux) or describes desktop-app passkey support. Missing for 10: explicit per-platform passkey support for iOS, Android, Windows and Linux; desktop-app passkey usage; any independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-ecosystem passkey sync.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor

citations.quote: Save passkeys in your Bitwarden vault and use the browser extension or mobile apps to autofill them across the apps and websites you use every day.
The most trusted open source password manager for passwords, passkeys, and secrets
